purpose: Define the minimum provenance package for every numerical statement in the eventual paper.
run_rules: Historical result artifacts must be produced by or explicitly bound to the source hash they claim.
A later source checkout cannot retroactively certify an older run.
Synthetic results must be labeled synthetic and cannot fill a historical case cell.
Exploratory diagnostics must be labeled exploratory and cannot be silently relabeled preregistered.
Failed and null runs remain addressable artifacts.
Measurement operators and split definitions are versioned independently of model source.
Any manual data transformation used in a paper result must have a source manifest and transformation record.
